summary: Russian forces launched a massive coordinated missile and drone barrage across seven Ukrainian regions overnight, striking Kyiv, Kharkiv, Zaporizhzhia, Dnipro, Chernihiv, Odesa, and Sumy with ballistic missiles, Shahed variants, and guided bombs, causing at least four deaths and 27+ injuries including children. Ukrainian long-range drones conducted their fifth 2026 strike on the Afipsky refinery in Krasnodar Krai and hit the Novoshakhtinsky refinery in Rostov region, killing two and forcing a shutdown. Russian ground forces advanced near Dorozhnie and Sofiivka in eastern Donetsk per DeepState mapping.
key_points: Russian ballistic missiles struck Kremenchuk; Shahed drones targeted Odesa, Danube ports, Konotop, and Chornomorsk overnight. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70971, @mon1tor_ua/71006)
Russian missiles hit Kyiv high-rise, Kharkiv industrial zone, Zaporizhzhia with KABs, Dnipro mall, and Mena (Chernihiv) injuring 13 including children. (Source: @UkraineNow/83672)
Ukrainian drones hit Afipsky refinery (Krasnodar) fifth time in 2026 and Novoshakhtinsky refinery (Rostov), causing fires, two deaths, two injuries. (Source: @eRadarrua/107029, @UkraineNow/83675)
Russian forces advanced near Dorozhnie and Sofiivka per DeepState map update. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23776)
Russian tactical aviation active in southeastern sector; threat of air strikes on frontline areas reported. (Source: @kpszsu/74426)
Half a million 155mm shells contracted for AFU via Romanian, Canadian, Serbian supply chain through 2027. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32725)
European leaders to visit U.S. to press Trump for Patriot missile transfers to Ukraine. (Source: @UkraineNow/83674)
Russian Geran drones now feature real-time operator control with autonomous target acquisition, per Zelensky adviser. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32716)

Ukrainian long-range drones conducted their fifth 2026 strike on the Afipsky refinery in Krasnodar Krai and hit the Novoshakhtinsky refinery in Rostov region, killing two and forcing a shutdown. points: Ukrainian long-range drones conducted fifth strike on Afipsky oil refinery in Krasnodar Krai in 2026, with debris hitting Afipskaya railway station; simultaneously struck Novoshakhtinsky refinery in Rostov region forcing shutdown, per regional governors. (Source: @eRadarrua/107029, @UkraineNow/83675)

Ukraine securing 530,000 155mm shells via Romanian Arsenal Resita and Canadian CellCore Technologies, delivered through British Torman and U.S. Sphere Ventures, with Serbian fuses from Focus Strategies, scheduled through spring 2027. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32725)

European leaders planning U.S. visit to persuade Trump administration to provide Patriot missiles amid growing interceptor shortage exacerbated by U.S. operations against Iran. (Source: @UkraineNow/83674, @tass_agency/391935)

Ukrainian air defense engaged multiple Shahed drone groups over Odesa, Mykolaiv, Sumy, Poltava, Zaporizhzhia, and Kharkiv regions overnight per monitoring channels. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71006, @kpszsu/74449, @kpszsu/74437, @kpszsu/74422, @kpszsu/74440, @eRadarrua/107027, @eRadarrua/107053)

Zelensky adviser Beskrestnov stated Russian Geran jet drones now feature real-time operator control with autonomous target acquisition from kilometers away, rendering electronic warfare ineffective. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32716)
Russian forces launched two ballistic missiles at Kremenchuk and threatened Iskander-M launches from Taganrog, Rostov region, per monitoring alerts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70971, @mon1tor_ua/70968)

Russian strikes hit Kyiv (Holosiivskyi district 16-story building, 1 injured), Kharkiv (industrial zone, 1 killed), Zaporizhzhia (KABs, 2 killed), Dnipro (Karavan mall, fire), Mena in Chernihiv region (13 injured including 4 children). (Source: @UkraineNow/83672)

Mass Shahed drone attack overnight: 5 Shaheds on Izmail/Reni/Kiliya, 4 on Odesa/Chornomorsk, 3 reactive Shaheds on Konotop, 1 loitering over Konotop, plus UAVs toward Chornomorsk, Mykolaiv, Zaporizhzhia, Poltava, Lozova, Vylkove, Bilopillia. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71006, @kpszsu/74449, @kpszsu/74437, @kpszsu/74422, @kpszsu/74440, @kpszsu/74414, @eRadarrua/107027)
Russian tactical aviation active in southeastern direction with threat of air strikes on frontline areas per KPSZSU warning. (Source: @kpszsu/74426)

Kremlin spokesman Peskov dismissed Western talk of possible Russian defeat as "very big deception"; Medvedev warned Armenia's EU application will damage relations with Russia and EAEU. (Source: @tass_agency/391907, @tass_agency/391936)
Russian forces advanced near Dorozhnie and Sofiivka according to DeepState map update, indicating continued pressure in eastern Donetsk sector. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23776)

Russian reactive UAVs launched from Donbas toward Lozova (Kharkiv region) and jet UAV toward Zaporizhzhia city from west, suggesting continued air pressure on eastern operational depth. (Source: @eRadarrua/107027, @kpszsu/74414)
Russian Geran-5 drones (2 units) targeted Dnipro/Kamianske area, demonstrating strike capability against central Ukrainian logistics hubs. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70975)
Russian tactical aviation activity reported on southeastern front with threat of guided bomb and missile strikes on forward positions and rear areas. (Source: @kpszsu/74426)

Russian reactive Shahed drones (3 groups) attacked Konotop in Sumy region with one loitering overhead; additional reactive UAVs struck near Bilopillia, Sumy region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71006, @eRadarrua/107027)
Russian missile strike on Mena, Chernihiv region injured 13 people including 4 children, per UkraineNow report. (Source: @UkraineNow/83672)
Russian controlled UAV and reactive UAV group detected in Kharkiv region per eRadar monitoring. (Source: @eRadarrua/107053)
Russian ballistic missile threat from Taganrog (Rostov region) covers northern Ukrainian regions including Sumy, Chernihiv, Kharkiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70968)

Massive Shahed drone barrage from Black Sea: 5 Shaheds targeting Izmail, Reni, Kiliya (Danube delta ports); 4 Shaheds on Odesa and Chornomorsk; UAV toward Chornomorsk from sea; UAV toward Mykolaiv region from sea; UAV toward Vylkove from sea. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71006, @kpszsu/74449, @kpszsu/74437, @eRadarrua/107027)

Ukrainian drone strike on Afipsky refinery (Krasnodar Krai) and Novoshakhtinsky refinery (Rostov region) demonstrates reach into southern Russian energy infrastructure. (Source: @eRadarrua/107029, @UkraineNow/83675)
Border crossing point Vynohradivka-Vulcanesti (Moldova) suspended due to Russian attack per State Border Guard Service. (Source: @UkraineNow/83672)

Russian Geran jet drones now feature real-time operator control with autonomous terminal guidance to specific targets (locomotives, malls, ships) from kilometers away, per Zelensky adviser Beskrestnov. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32716)
Russian forces employing mixed drone types: Shahed-136/131 ("banderyoli"), Geran-5, reactive Shaheds, controlled UAVs, reconnaissance UAVs across multiple axes simultaneously. (Source: @mon1
